correctness.rationale: The repaired theorem retains the valid mathematics and identifies the dimension-two comparison explicitly. The one-dimensional exclusion is commutativity; two-factor invariance is similarity, and transposition and cyclic permutations exhaust the three-factor symmetric permutations. These facts use invertibility and symmetry, not entrywise strict positivity of the individual factors. The independently written /workspace/branches/6e05f9a8-75de-4e6f-b3de-78b0c6a36c2a/record2_replay.py checks all four exact products, their threshold inequalities and both parametric trace differences. The bound script was inspected, not executed. Strict spectral inequalities persist by continuity, including within the nonnegative symmetric class after splitting the repeated factor. In the model interpretation the cube is invariant and the flow order-preserving (off-diagonal derivatives nonnegative there); linear domination and a Perron-vector subsolution justify the two strict conclusions by iteration. No general attractivity result or critical-case verdict follows. In two groups, zero-diagonal reciprocal contacts all have the same off-diagonal matrix up to scalar, hence commute; diagonal within-group terms remove that obstruction.
